title: Differential Geometry in R3
description: Curves in the plane and 3-dimensional space, curvature and torsion, Frenet-Serret apparatus, surfaces in 3-dimensional space, Gaussian and mean curvature, Theorema Egregium, Gauss-Bonnet theorem, elements of non-euclidean geometry.
notes: Not open for credit to students with credit in MATH 436 or MATH 467.
